top_signals.title: Natixis Raises Japan Stocks Allocation, Cuts US Equity Exposure
top_signals.summary: Natixis Investment Managers has raised its allocation to Japanese equities, betting the nation’s economic growth momentum will endure as inflationary pressures push government bond yields higher, its strategists told Bloomberg in a recent interview.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Sality, one of the longest-running botnets, finally gets disrupted
top_signals.summary: U.S. and European authorities disrupted the long-running botnet Sality, turning the malware’s peer-to-peer architecture against itself to cut thousands of infected computers off from operators.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen surges to briefly touch low 158 level as intervention concerns linger
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: States now must report undocumented immigrants to DHS or risk federal funding, DOJ says
top_signals.summary: The new DOJ opinion relates to funding states get for Temporary Assistance for Needy Families and the Supplemental Security Income programs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Burnham tries to calm bond markets as public spending fears mount
top_signals.summary: Kemi Badenoch accuses Labour leader of being unable to refuse spending requests in first Prime Minister’s Questions

top_signals.title: Trump meets with travel industry CEOs on push to boost foreign tourism
top_signals.summary: International arrivals to the U.S. have declined, with travel officials citing a number of factors that include lengthy visa interview wait times and higher airline ticket prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to decide who regulates sports betting on prediction markets
top_signals.summary: New Jersey is asking the U.S. Supreme Court to settle, once and for all, how sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated.
